seo.title: Your Company — freight from China and Turkey to Tashkent
seo.description: Groupage and full loads from China, Turkey and Europe to Uzbekistan: road, rail and air, customs clearance, a warehouse in Tashkent. A quote within an hour.
seo.answer: Your Company ships freight to Tashkent from China (road 18–22 days, from $1.9/kg; rail 25–30 days, from $120/m³), Turkey (10–14 days, from $2.4/kg) and Europe (14–20 days, from $2.9/kg), handles customs from $150 per declaration and stores goods at its own warehouse in Sergeli.

business.street: 22 Yangi Sergeli St, warehouse 4, Sergeli district

sections.title: Freight to Tashkent, on schedule
sections.subtitle: Groupage and full loads by road, rail and air. We collect from the supplier, clear customs, store at our own warehouse and deliver to your door — one contract and one manager for the whole route.

sections.label: Company
sections.title: Logistics without “I’ll check tomorrow”
sections.text: Since 2017 we have moved freight for retailers, manufacturers and marketplace sellers. Our own consolidation warehouses in Yiwu and Istanbul, our own customs broker and a bonded warehouse in Tashkent. Every shipment is visible in tracking: where the cargo is, when it reaches the border, when it is unloaded. If a date slips, we tell you first and explain why.

sections.title: Departures board

items.title: Request
items.text: Send an invoice or a list of goods — we quote the rate and transit time within an hour.

items.title: Pick-up
items.text: We collect from the supplier, check the quantity and take photos.

items.title: Consolidation
items.text: We pack, label and build the shipment at our warehouse.

items.title: Unloading and delivery
items.text: Free storage for 7 days, then delivery to your warehouse or store.

items.quote: We ship tableware from Yiwu twice a month. Not a single lost box in a year, and tracking put an end to “where is the cargo” calls.
items.author: Dilshod R.

items.quote: They cleared equipment from Germany on the first try: the broker found the right code in advance and gathered the certificates.
items.author: Anna K.

items.quote: They quote fast and don’t change the rate at the border. For a marketplace seller, that’s what matters.
items.author: Bekhzod T.

items.q: How long does freight from China to Tashkent take?
items.a: Road — 18–22 days from the Yiwu or Guangzhou warehouse, rail — 25–30 days, air — 5–7 days. The transit time is fixed in the contract and you can follow it in tracking.

items.q: Can I send a small shipment?
items.a: Yes, as groupage from 30 kg. We combine your boxes with other clients’ cargo, so you pay only for your own weight or volume.
Insurance is optional: 0.5% of the declared invoice value. In case of damage or loss we compensate under the insurance policy.
Yes, we have our own customs broker. We select the HS code, calculate duties in advance and arrange certificates — a declaration from $150.

items.q: Where is the cargo stored after arrival?
items.a: At our warehouse in Sergeli: the first 7 days are free, then $1 per m³ per day. You can collect it yourself or order delivery across the city.
By bank transfer in UZS or USD under the contract. 50% prepayment after the rate is confirmed, the balance before the cargo is released.

sections.label: Quote
sections.title: Send an invoice — we’ll quote within an hour
sections.text: Tell us what you are shipping, from where and the approximate volume. We’ll reply with a rate, transit time and a list of documents.
